camel_example: aliyun alb CreateServerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckHost 'www.example.com' --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckProtocol HTTP --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckPath '/test/index.html' --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckHttpVersion 'HTTP1.1' --HealthCheckConfig.UnhealthyThreshold 3 --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckInterval 2 --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckMethod HEAD --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckEnabled true --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckTimeout 5 --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckConnectPort 80 --HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckCodes.1 http_2xx --HealthCheckConfig.HealthyThreshold 3 --ServerGroupName test --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a server group in a specified region
description_zh: 在指定地域创建服务器组
name: CreateServerGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the server group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with a letter, Chinese character, or digit. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 服务器组名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母、中文或数字开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: server_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

Instance (default): server type. This type of server group supports adding Ecs, Eni, and Eci instances.

Ip: IP address type. This type of server group supports adding backend servers of the IP address type.

Fc: Function Compute type. This type supports adding backend servers of the Function Compute type
parameters.help_zh:
服务器组类型。取值：

Instance（默认值）：服务器类型，该类型服务器组支持添加Ecs、Eni、Eci实例。

Ip：IP地址类型，该类型服务器组支持添加IP地址类型的后端服务器。

Fc：函数计算类型，该类型支持添加函数计算类型的后端服务器
parameters.name: server_group_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC. Only servers in this VPC can be added to the server group.

This parameter takes effect only when ServerGroupType is set to Instance or Ip
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例ID。只有该VPC下的服务器可以加入到该服务器组。

ServerGroupType取值为Instance或Ip时，该参数生效
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

Wrr (default): weighted round-robin. Backend servers with higher weights are more likely to be polled.

Wlc: weighted least connections. In addition to polling based on the weight of each backend server, this algorithm also considers the actual load (number of connections) of the backend servers. When the weights are the same, backend servers with fewer current connections are more likely to be polled.

Sch: consistent hashing. Requests with the same hash factor calculation result are scheduled to the same backend server. If the UchConfig parameter is not configured, the default hash factor is the source IP address, and requests from the same source IP address are distributed to the same backend server. If the UchConfig parameter is configured, the hash factor is the URL parameter, and requests with the same URL parameter are distributed to the same backend server.

This parameter takes effect only when ServerGroupType is set to Instance or Ip
parameters.help_zh:
调度算法。取值：

Wrr（默认值）：加权轮询，权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的概率也越高。

Wlc：加权最小连接数，除了根据每台后端服务器设定的权重值来进行轮询，同时还考虑后端服务器的实际负载（即连接数）。当权重值相同时，当前连接数越小的后端服务器被轮询到的概率也越高。

Sch：一致性哈希，相同哈希因子计算结果的请求将会调度到相同的后端服务器。不配置UchConfig参数时，默认哈希因子为源IP，相同源IP地址的请求会分发到同一台后端服务器；配置了UchConfig参数时，哈希因子为URL参数，相同URL参数的请求会分发到同一台后端服务器。


ServerGroupType取值为Instance或Ip时，该参数生效
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
The backend protocol. Valid values:

HTTP (default): supports associating HTTPS, HTTP, and QUIC listeners.

HTTPS: supports associating HTTPS listeners.

gRPC: supports associating HTTPS and QUIC listeners.

You do not need to configure the backend protocol when ServerGroupType is set to Fc
parameters.help_zh:
后端协议。取值：

HTTP（默认值）：支持关联HTTPS、HTTP和QUIC监听。

HTTPS：支持关联HTTPS监听。

gRPC：关联HTTPS和QUIC监听。

ServerGroupType取值为Fc时，无需配置后端协议
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The list of status codes that indicate a successful health check
fields.help_zh: 健康检查正常的状态码列表
fields.name: health_check_codes

fields.help_en:
The port of the backend server used for health checks.

Valid values: 0 to 65535.

Default value: 0, which indicates that the port of the backend server is used for health checks
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的后端服务器的端口。

取值范围：  0~65535。

默认值：0，表示使用后端服务器的端口进行健康检查
fields.name: health_check_connect_port

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values:

true: enables health checks.

false: disables health checks.

By default, health checks are enabled when ServerGroupType is set to Instance or Ip. By default, health checks are disabled when ServerGroupType is set to Fc
fields.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查，取值：

true：开启

false：不开启

ServerGroupType取值为Instance或Ip时，默认开启健康检查。ServerGroupType取值为Fc时，默认不开启健康检查
fields.name: health_check_enabled

fields.help_en:
The domain name used for health checks.

Internal IP address of the backend server (default): uses the internal IP address of the backend server as the domain name for health checks.

Specified domain name: specifies a domain name.

The domain name must be 1 to 80 characters in length.

It can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and periods (.).

It must contain at least one period (.), and the period (.) cannot be at the beginning or end.

The rightmost domain label can contain only letters, and cannot contain digits or hyphens (-).

A hyphen (-) cannot be at the beginning or end.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP, HTTPS, or gRPC
fields.help_zh:
健康检查域名。

使用后端服务器的内网IP（默认）：使用后端服务器的内网IP地址作为健康检查的域名。

指定特定域名：输入一个域名。

长度限制为1~80个字符。

可包含小写字母、数字、短划线（-）和半角句号（.）。

至少包含一个半角句号（.），半角句号（.）不能出现在开头或结尾。

最右侧的域标签，只能包含字母，不能包含数字或短划线（-）。

短划线（-）不能出现在开头或结尾。

只有HealthCheckProtocol设置为HTTP、HTTPS或gRPC时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_host

fields.help_en:
The HTTP version for health checks. Valid values: HTTP1.0 and HTTP1.1 (default).

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS
fields.help_zh:
健康检查HTTP协议版本，取值：HTTP1.0或HTTP1.1（默认值）。

只有HealthCheckProtocol设置为HTTP或HTTPS时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_http_version

fields.help_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 2
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。单位：秒。

取值范围：1~50。

默认值：2
fields.name: health_check_interval

fields.help_en:
The HTTP method used for health checks. Valid values:

GET: if the length of the response packet exceeds 8 KB, the packet is truncated, but the health check result is not affected.

POST: the default method for gRPC listener health checks.

HEAD (default): the default method for HTTP and HTTPS listener health checks.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP, HTTPS, or gRPC
fields.help_zh:
健康检查方法，取值：

GET：如果响应报文长度超过8K，会被截断，但不会影响健康检查结果的判定。

POST：gRPC监听健康检查默认采用POST方法。

HEAD（默认值）：HTTP和HTTPS监听健康检查默认采用HEAD方法。

只有HealthCheckProtocol设置为HTTP或HTTPS或gRPC时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_method

fields.help_en:
The forwarding rule path for health checks.

The path must be 1 to 80 characters in length. It can contain only letters, digits, the characters `-/.%?#&=`, and extended characters such as `_~!()*[]@$^:',+`. The URL must start with a forward slash (/).

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的转发规则路径。

长度为1~80个字符，只能使用字母、数字、字符`-/.%?#&=`以及扩展字符`_;~!（)*[]@$^:',+`。 URL必须以正斜线（/）开头。

只有HealthCheckProtocol设置为HTTP或HTTPS时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_path

fields.help_en:
The protocol used for health checks. Valid values:

HTTP: sends HEAD or GET requests to simulate browser access behavior and check whether the server application is healthy.

HTTPS: sends HEAD or GET requests to simulate browser access behavior and check whether the server application is healthy. Data is encrypted, making it more secure than HTTP.

TCP: sends SYN handshake packets to check whether the server port is alive.

gRPC: sends POST or GET requests to check whether the server application is healthy
fields.help_zh:
健康检查协议，取值：

HTTP：通过发送HEAD或GET请求模拟浏览器的访问行为来检查服务器应用是否健康。

HTTPS：通过发送HEAD或GET请求模拟浏览器的访问行为来检查服务器应用是否健康。（数据加密，相比HTTP更安全。）

TCP：通过发送SYN握手报文来检测服务器端口是否存活。

gRPC：通过发送POST或GET请求来检查服务器应用是否健康
fields.name: health_check_protocol

fields.help_en:
The timeout period for a health check response. If the backend server does not respond within the specified timeout period, the health check fails. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 300.

Default value: 5
fields.help_zh:
接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端服务器在指定的时间内没有正确响应，则判定为健康检查失败。单位：秒。

取值范围：1~300。

默认值：5
fields.name: health_check_timeout

fields.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks that must occur before the health check status of a backend server is changed from Failed to Successful.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 3
fields.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由失败判定为成功。

取值范围：2~10。

默认值：3
fields.name: healthy_threshold

fields.help_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks that must occur before the health check status of a backend server is changed from Successful to Failed.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 3
fields.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由成功判定为失败。

取值范围：2~10。

默认值：3
fields.name: unhealthy_threshold

fields.help_en:
The cookie configured on the server.

The cookie must be 1 to 200 characters in length, and can contain only ASCII letters and digits. It cannot contain commas (,), semicolons (;), or spaces, and cannot start with a dollar sign ($).

This parameter takes effect only when StickySessionEnabled is set to true and StickySessionType is set to server
fields.help_zh:
服务器上配置的Cookie。

长度为1~200个字符，只能包含ASCII英文字母和数字字符，不能包含半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）或空格，也不能以美元符号（$）开头。

当StickySessionEnabled为true且StickySessionType为server时，该参数生效
fields.name: cookie

fields.help_en:
The timeout period of the cookie. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 86400.

Default value: 1000.

This parameter takes effect only when StickySessionEnabled is set to true and StickySessionType is set to Insert
fields.help_zh:
Cookie超时时间。单位：秒。

取值范围：1~86400。

默认值：1000。

当StickySessionEnabled为true且StickySessionType为Insert时，该参数生效
fields.name: cookie_timeout

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable session persistence. Valid values:

true: enables session persistence.
false: disables session persistence.

This parameter takes effect only when ServerGroupType is set to Instance or Ip
fields.help_zh:
是否启用会话保持，取值：

true：开启
false：不开启。

ServerGroupType取值为Instance或Ip时，该参数生效
fields.name: sticky_session_enabled

fields.help_en:
The method used to handle cookies. Valid values:

Insert (default): inserts a cookie.
When a client accesses the server for the first time, load balancing inserts a cookie (that is, inserts SERVERID into the HTTP or HTTPS response packet) into the response. The next time the client accesses the server with this cookie, the load balancing service forwards the request to the recorded backend server.

Server: rewrites a cookie.
When load balancing detects a user-defined cookie, it rewrites the original cookie. The next time the client accesses the server with the new cookie, the load balancing service forwards the request to the recorded backend server.

This parameter takes effect only when StickySessionEnabled is set to true
fields.help_zh:
Cookie的处理方式。取值：

Insert（默认值）：植入Cookie。
客户端第一次访问时，负载均衡会在返回请求中植入Cookie（即在HTTP或HTTPS响应报文中插入SERVERID），下次客户端携带此Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器上。

Server：重写Cookie。
负载均衡发现用户自定义了Cookie，将会对原来的Cookie进行重写，下次客户端携带新的Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器。

当StickySessionEnabled的值为true时，该参数生效
fields.name: sticky_session_type

parameters.help_en:
The session persistence configuration.

This parameter takes effect only when ServerGroupType is set to Instance or Ip
parameters.help_zh:
会话保持配置结构体。

ServerGroupType取值为Instance或Ip时，该参数生效
parameters.name: sticky_session_config

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

true: prechecks the request without creating the server group. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the precheck, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the precheck, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建服务器组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the IP protocol version used by load balancing to forward traffic to the backend server group supports IPv6. Valid values:
false (default): IPv6 is not supported. The IPv4 type supports adding only IPv4 backend servers.
true: dual-stack type. Both IPv4 and IPv6 backend servers can be added
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡向后端服务器组转发的IP协议版本是否支持IPv6。
false（默认值）：不支持IPv6， IPv4类型仅支持添加IPv4后端
true：双栈类型，支持同时添加IPv4和IPv6后端
parameters.name: ipv6_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable backend keep-alive. Valid values:

true: enables backend keep-alive.
false (default): disables backend keep-alive
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启后端长链接。

true：开启
false（默认值）：不开启
parameters.name: upstream_keepalive_enabled

parameters.help_en: The name of the `K8s Service` that corresponds to the server group. This parameter is applicable only to ALB Ingress scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 仅适用于ALB Ingress场景，表示服务器组对应的`K8s Service`名称
parameters.name: service_name

fields.help_en: The parameter type. Set the value to QueryString
fields.help_zh: 参数类型。只能填QueryString
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The consistent hashing parameter value
fields.help_zh: 一致性hash参数值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The URL consistent hashing parameter settings
parameters.name: uch_config

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable connection draining. Valid values:

true: enables connection draining.
false: disables connection draining (default)
fields.help_zh:
是否开启连接优雅中断。

true：开启
false：关闭（默认值）
fields.name: connection_drain_enabled

fields.help_en:
The connection draining timeout period.

Valid values: 0 to 900.

Default value: 300
fields.help_zh:
连接优雅中断超时时间。

取值范围：0~900。

默认值：300
fields.name: connection_drain_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The graceful connection break configuration.

After graceful connection break is enabled, load balancing ensures normal transmission of existing connections within a specified period after a backend server is removed or a health check has failed.


Basic Edition instances do not support graceful connection break. Only Standard Edition and WAF-enhanced Edition instances support this feature.
Server type and IP type server groups support graceful connection break. Function Compute type server groups do not support this feature
parameters.help_zh:
连接优雅中断相关配置。

开启连接优雅中断，在移除后端服务器或者健康检查失败后，负载均衡使现有连接在一定时间内正常传输。


基础版实例不支持开启连接优雅中断，仅标准版、WAF增强版实例支持。
服务器类型、IP类型服务器组支持连接优雅中断，函数计算类型不支持
parameters.name: connection_drain_config

fields.help_en:
The slow start duration.

Valid values: 30 to 900.

Default value: 30
fields.help_zh:
慢启动持续时间。

取值范围：30~900。

默认值：30
fields.name: slow_start_duration

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable slow start. Valid values:

true: enables slow start.
false: disables slow start (default)
fields.help_zh:
是否开启慢启动。

true：开启
false：关闭（默认值）
fields.name: slow_start_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The slow start configuration.

After slow start is enabled, newly added backend servers in the server group are warmed up within the specified time period, and the number of requests forwarded to the servers increases linearly.


Basic Edition instances do not support slow start. Only Standard Edition and WAF-enhanced Edition instances support this feature.
Server type and IP backend server groups support slow start. Function Compute backend server groups do not support this feature.
Slow start can be enabled only when the backend scheduling algorithm is weighted round-robin
parameters.help_zh:
慢启动相关配置。

开启慢启动后，将会在设定的时间段内对新添加到后端服务器组的后端服务器进行预热，转发到该服务器的请求数量线性增加。


基础版实例不支持开启慢启动，仅标准版、WAF增强版实例支持。
服务器类型、IP类型服务器组支持配置慢启动，函数计算类型不支持。
慢启动仅在后端调度算法是加权轮询算法时可开启
parameters.name: slow_start_config

fields.help_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cross-zone load balancing for the server group. Valid values:

true: enables cross-zone load balancing (default).

false: disables cross-zone load balancing.


Basic Edition instances do not support binding server groups with cross-zone load balancing disabled. Only Standard Edition and WAF-enhanced Edition instances support this feature.
Server type and IP type server groups support disabling cross-zone load balancing. Function Compute type server groups do not support this feature.
Session persistence cannot be enabled when cross-zone load balancing is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
服务器组是否开启跨AZ负载均衡。取值：

true：开启（默认值）

false：关闭


基础版实例不支持绑定关闭跨AZ负载均衡的服务器组，仅标准版、WAF 增强版实例支持。
服务器类型、IP 类型服务器组支持关闭跨AZ负载均衡，函数计算类型不支持。
关闭跨AZ负载均衡时，不支持开启会话保持
parameters.name: cross_zone_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The IP version affinity mode. Valid values:
NonAffinity: No affinity mode. This is the default value.
Affinity: Affinity mode.  

This parameter takes effect only when Ipv6Enabled is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
IP版本亲和模式：
NonAffinity（默认值）：无亲和模式
Affinity：亲和模式  

仅当Ipv6Enabled=true时生效
parameters.name: ip_version_affinity_mode

JobId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task

ServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the server group
